title: Pricing & Packaging Lead
description:
About Hightouch

Hightouch is an Agentic Marketing Platform powered by the industry-leading Composable CDP. With complete brand context, customer data, and performance history in one place, every marketer finally has the power to build and ship end-to-end campaigns themselves. Teams move faster, stay on brand, and get AI marketing that actually works.

Founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Francisco, Hightouch enables marketing teams to analyze performance, brainstorm ideas, and generate creative at a speed and quality that wasn't previously possible.

Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Customer Data Platforms, Hightouch is trusted by leading enterprises like Domino's, Spotify, Aritzia, Cars.com, Ramp, and PetSmart.

At Hightouch, our mission is to help our customers leverage data and AI to grow their businesses. The team is ambitious, impact-driven, efficient - and we believe humility, kindness, and compassion are essential to our success. If you're energized by velocity, obsessed with raising the bar, and want to build alongside people who care deeply about each other and our customers, we'd love to meet you.

The Role

We're hiring our first dedicated Pricing & Packaging Lead. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who wants to own how Hightouch monetizes, not administer a rate card someone else set.

Hightouch has grown from 10 to 100 account executives in under two years, and the product has diversified well beyond its Reverse ETL origins: Customer Studio, Identity Resolution, Journeys, Event Collection and Real-Time Audiences, Match Booster, and a fast-expanding set of AI products with a base + consumption pricing profile. Each launched with its own pricing logic, and the frameworks that got us here won't get us to the next stage. We need a central lead who owns the whole picture, from strategy through the systems that make it real, and who is in the room with our Co-CEOs, CRO, CFO, and product leaders as new pricing gets designed.

This role reports to our Head of Revenue Operations and sits alongside the Deal Desk Lead. Deal Desk owns the transaction: structuring, approvals, and quote accuracy on individual deals. You own the frameworks Deal Desk enforces, and you'll partner with Deal Desk and our front-line sales managers (AEMs) on the largest deals. You'll be hands-on-keyboard from day one and are expected to be a builder and scaler.

What You'll Do

Co-create pricing and packaging with executive and product leadership. Own the pricing and packaging agenda. Partner directly with our Co-CEOs, CRO, CFO, and Product leaders on how new products get packaged, metered, and priced: value metrics, tiers, platform fee structure, commit and drawdown mechanics, overage and true-up rules, floors, and how it all lands on an order form. Run the pricing workstream for every material launch so pricing is decided before the product ships. Build the analysis behind each decision (willingness-to-pay, win/loss and discount data, competitive benchmarking, margin and rev-rec implications) and bring a recommendation, not a menu. Own the decision through rollout, then pressure-test it against real deals and revise where it breaks.

Rationalize and own the current pricing frameworks. Inventory everything we sell and how we price it today, across Platform, Customer Studio, AI products, Event Collection and RTA, Match Booster, and adjacent SKUs. Consolidate overlapping or contradictory frameworks into one coherent price book with clear list prices, unit definitions, bundling rules, and discount guidance by segment and deal size. Define what is standard, what is an exception, and what we no longer offer. Set uplift and repricing standards for renewals and expansions, including how legacy contracts migrate onto current packaging. Report discount depth, price realization, and packaging mix to leadership on a regular cadence.

title: Senior Director of Customer Success

About Clearstory

Clearstory is a construction change order management platform that brings clarity and control to complex projects. We replace the traditional methods of tracking change orders - email, Excel, and paper - with intelligent automation and real-time collaboration between GCs, specialty contractors, and owners. Teams on Clearstory share over $2B in CORs monthly, and more than 50% of ENR's Top 50 GCs trust the platform. We're a ~100-person, Series B company headquartered in San Francisco with a distributed team across the US.
The Role
We're hiring a Senior Director of Customer Success to own our entire post-sale organization: a team of 12 CSMs across two segments (General Contractors and Specialty Contractors), a growing management layer, and customer support. You'll be accountable for gross and net revenue retention across the customer base and report directly to the CRO.
This is a rare setup: you're inheriting a healthy, high-performing team with strong operating frameworks, documented processes, and an established forecasting discipline - built by a leader who is moving into a company-wide operations role. Your mandate isn't to fix something broken. It's to take full ownership, develop the management bench, and scale the organization ahead of the company's growth.

What You'll Own

• Retention outcomes. Full accountability for GRR and NRR across enterprise, mid-market, and SMB customers - including the forecasting cadence and retention planning that drive them.

• The team. 12 CSMs, 1 CS manager, and 2 support agents. You'll coach managers, develop career paths, and complete open hiring on the management layer.

• Enterprise relationships. Direct ownership of executive relationships with our largest customers.

• Operating rigor. Weekly and monthly operating cadences - portfolio reviews, call coaching, QBRs, onboarding execution - enforced consistently across segments.

• Cross-functional leadership. The face of CS with Sales (handoffs, account planning), Product (escalations, feature input), and Finance (renewals, forecasting).

• Efficiency and AI adoption. Evolving coverage models, tooling, and AI-assisted workflows so revenue under management grows faster than headcount.

Requirements

• 8+ years in Customer Success, including 4+ years leading CS teams at B2B SaaS companies

• Experience managing managers and running a multi-segment CS org

• Direct ownership of a retention number at a company between $10M-$50M ARR

• A track record of building repeatable process: operating cadences, forecast discipline, onboarding and QBR programs

• Executive presence - you can coach a call review in the morning and present retention strategy to the board in the afternoon

• A high-ownership mindset: the number is yours from day one

Nice to have: construction industry or vertical SaaS experience. Our CSMs bring deep domain expertise - we need you to bring world-class CS leadership.
Why This Role

• Own a complete function

• Inherit strength, not a turnaround - strong team, strong process, strong retention

• Real scope: retention is the engine of the business at this stage, and you'll run it

• A company culture built on our values: Be Curious, Keep It Simple, Customer Obsession, Raise the Bar

Benefits

• Ability to work with a new product category that has already found product market fit

• Remote work schedule

• Executive interaction regularly

• Competitive market-rate salary for a Series B company

• Subsidized healthcare, vision, and dental

• Early equity!

title: CENTRALE LYON - PhD Silicon Photonics for Scalable Energy-Efficient AI Hardware Accelerators
tags: INL - Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon
description: The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence (AI) applications across cloud and edge environments is driving the need for highly efficient hardware capable of supporting increasingly demanding workloads. Among these, matrix multiplication - particularly General Matrix Multiplication (GEMM) - remains the dominant computational kernel in modern AI models, including deep neural networks and transformer architectures. Conventional electronic accelerators, while highly optimized, face growing challenges related to energy consumption, data movement, and scalability. Silicon photonics has emerged as a promising technology to address these limitations by enabling highbandwidth, low-latency, and potentially energy-efficient computation through optical signal processing. In particular, recent advances in photonic computing leveraging phase-change materials (PCM) offer new opportunities for implementing reconfigurable and non-volatile computational primitives directly in the optical domain. This PhD is part of the CAMELIA program (ASIC and Numérique agencies) within the targeted project LEAF, and aims to explore a hybrid photonic-electronic computing paradigm for AI acceleration. The central objective is to design and evaluate silicon photonics-based architectures for efficient GEMM operations, building on recent work demonstrating a reconfigurable photonic GEMM architecture based on PCM and stochastic computing. The proposed research will focus on extending this tile-based photonic GEMM approach toward large-scale matrix operations under realistic conditions. Key challenges include managing PCM-related constraints such as limited precision and quantization effects, mitigating noise and variability, and addressing interface latency between photonic and electronic domains.
